tool_input.command:
cat > /tmp/opencode/proj_check.py <<'EOF'
from __future__ import annotations
import json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from slopgate._types import object_dict
from slopgate.adapters.opencode import OpenCodeAdapter
from slopgate.adapters.opencode_projection.projector import project_opencode_tool_input
from slopgate.adapters.opencode_projection.models import ProjectionRequest, OPENCODE_TOOL_CONTRACT_VERSION

def run(label: str, root: Path, tool_input: dict[str, object]) -> None:
    req = ProjectionRequest(
        tool_name="edit",
        tool_input=tool_input,
        root=root,
        contract_version=OPENCODE_TOOL_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    )
    print(f"--- {label} ---")
    print(json.dumps(project_opencode_tool_input(req), indent=1)[:600])

root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="proj-check-"))
(root / "src").mkdir()
(root / "src" / "app.py").write_text("VALUE = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")

# 1. delete=true with edits=[] on existing file (bead claim: currently projects unchanged edit)
run("delete=true edits=[] existing", root, {"filePath": "src/app.py", "delete": True, "edits": []})
# 2. delete=true with edits=[] on missing file
run("delete=true edits=[] missing", root, {"filePath": "src/nope.py", "delete": True, "edits": []})
# 3. rename-after-edit
run("rename-after-edit", root, {"filePath": "src/app.py", "rename": "src/renamed.py", "edits": [{"op": "append", "lines": ["VALUE = 2"]}]})
# 4. delete+rename (native-invalid)
run("delete+rename (native invalid)", root, {"filePath": "src/app.py", "delete": True, "rename": "src/other.py", "edits": []})
# 5. delete + nonempty edits (native-invalid)
run("delete+nonempty edits (native invalid)", root, {"filePath": "src/app.py", "delete": True, "edits": [{"op": "append", "lines": ["VALUE = 2"]}]})
EOF
cd $REPO_SLOPGATE && uv run --quiet python /tmp/opencode/proj_check.py
